_comment: fleet-ops#1222: Weekly Fleet Review quality ratchet (ledger 2026-08-27 | Quality ratchet). Cuts only tighten (down), one notch per week, evidence-based. Loosening requires a Nish ledger waiver. Each knob.cut must equal the live value in quality-routing.json.
_comment_ceilings: fleet-ops#3519: per-repo, per-metric quality ceilings. The Sunday fleet-weekly-review ratchets each ceiling to min(current, observed p50 x 1.1) — it never loosens; loosening needs a PR with a dated reason and Nish's word. Seeds are the measured 2026-09-05 baseline for 0509 (reverts 4.5/100, red-on-main ~6h=360min, sessions-to-PR 33%); metrics without a measured baseline (defects, rework, act-on) seed conservatively-loose so the first ratchet week sets real values. Metrics whose computation is deferred (rework_rate_pct, red_on_main_minutes, review_act_on_rate) carry their seeds now so the shape is complete; separate issues wire their exporters. '_default' covers product repos without their own row until the ratchet gives them one. 2026-09-09 seed correction (repair-dispatch, QualitySessionsPrCeiling firing 60m+): the 33 seed was never a measurement of the shipped sessions/merges gauge — that gauge read ~220 on the 2026-09-05 seed date (77 session dirs / 35 merges in the trailing 7d), so the ceiling was breached from the moment it was committed. The gauge's structural floor is ~100 (one claim session per landed PR is the optimum, not churn). Corrected to observed x 1.1 per this file's own min(current, p50 x 1.1) ratchet formula — a mis-seed fix, not a ratchet loosening; live 2026-09-09 value is 103.7, under half the seed-date reading.
